package v1

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"connectrpc.com/connect"
	"github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2/runtime"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v5"
	"golang.org/x/sync/semaphore"

	"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/profile"
	v1pb "github.com/usememos/memos/proto/gen/api/v1"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/auth"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/notification"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/store"
)

const maxAPIRequestBytes = 256 << 20

type APIV1Service struct {
	v1pb.UnimplementedInstanceServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedUserServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedMemoServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAttachmentServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAIServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedIdentityProviderServiceServer

	Secret                  string
	Profile                 *profile.Profile
	Store                   *store.Store
	MarkdownService         markdown.Service
	SSEHub                  *SSEHub
	NotificationEmailSender notification.EmailSender

	// thumbnailSemaphore limits concurrent thumbnail generation to prevent memory exhaustion
	thumbnailSemaphore       *semaphore.Weighted
	imageProcessingSemaphore *semaphore.Weighted

	// instanceStatsCache memoizes GetInstanceStats results for instanceStatsCacheTTL.
	instanceStatsCache instanceStatsCache
}

func NewAPIV1Service(secret string, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) *APIV1Service {
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
	return &APIV1Service{
		Secret:                   secret,
		Profile:                  profile,
		Store:                    store,
		MarkdownService:          markdownService,
		SSEHub:                   NewSSEHub(),
		NotificationEmailSender:  nil,
		thumbnailSemaphore:       semaphore.NewWeighted(3), // Limit to 3 concurrent thumbnail generations
		imageProcessingSemaphore: semaphore.NewWeighted(2),
	}
}

// RegisterGateway registers the gRPC-Gateway and Connect handlers with the given Echo instance.
func (s *APIV1Service) RegisterGateway(ctx context.Context, echoServer *echo.Echo) error {
	// Shared authorizer: one source of truth for authentication and anonymous-access
	// policy, used by both the gRPC-Gateway middleware and the Connect interceptor.
	authorizer := NewAuthorizer(s.Store, s.Secret, s.Profile)
	gatewayAuthMiddleware := func(next runtime.HandlerFunc) runtime.HandlerFunc {
		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, pathParams map[string]string) {
			ctx := r.Context()

			// The RPC method name is set by grpc-gateway after routing. When it can't be
			// determined, skip the policy check and let the service layer handle visibility.
			rpcMethod, ok := runtime.RPCMethod(ctx)

This is the Go backend of **memos** (usememos/memos). It uses **goldmark** internally for parsing, wrapped behind an in-house `Service` interface (frontend rendering to HTML is done separately via `markdown-it` in `web/`, so I focused on the Go abstraction as that's the closest thing to a true interface/DI abstraction).

### 1. Interface definition
- **File:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- **Type:** `Service` interface, lines 31–55 (package `markdown`)
- Methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`.

### 2. Concrete implementation(s)
- **Only one implementation exists**, in the same file: unexported struct `service` (line 58), which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` (line 59: `md goldmark.Markdown`). All interface methods are implemented on `*service` in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (e.g. `RenderHTML` at line 255, `RenderMarkdown` at line 244, `ExtractAll` at line 356, etc.). Internally it also delegates markdown-AST-to-text rendering to `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go` (`MarkdownRenderer` struct, not itself an implementer of `Service` — it's a helper used by `service.RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag`).
- **No mock/stub implementation of `Service` exists anywhere in the repo.** Tests (`internal/markdown/markdown_test.go`, `server/router/rss/rss_test.go`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go`, `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go`) all construct the real `service` via `markdown.NewService(...)` — there's no fake/mock swapped in for tests, so effectively the single concrete implementation runs in both production and tests.

### 3. Construction / wiring sites
Factory function: `NewService(opts ...Option) Service` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`.

Runtime (non-test) construction call sites:
- **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`** — inside `NewAPIV1Service(...)`, this is the actual production wiring root:
  ```go
  markdownService := markdown.NewService(
      markdown.WithTagExtension(),
      markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
  )
  ```
  Stored into `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (field declared at `v1.go:35`).

- From there it's threaded (not re-constructed) into other components:
  - `/bench/repo/server/server.go:85` — `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)` passes the already-constructed instance into the RSS service.
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447` — pass `s.MarkdownService` into `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(...)`.

Test-only construction sites (not part of the runtime path): `internal/markdown/markdown_test.go` (many `NewService()` calls), `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`, `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`.

### 4. Holders of the interface type (depend on abstraction, not concrete `service`)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` — `APIV1Service.MarkdownService markdown.Service`
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45` — `RSSService.MarkdownService markdown.Service` (constructor param at `rss.go:58`)
- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` — `Runner.MarkdownService markdown.Service` (constructor param at `runner.go:19`); also the free function `RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service)` at `runner.go:74` takes the interface as a parameter directly.

Note: `memopayload.Runner`/`NewRunner` (runner.go:14-23) appears to be dead/unused code in the production path — I found no call site for `NewRunner` or `Runner.RunOnce` anywhere in `server/` or `cmd/`; only the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function is actually invoked (from `memo_service.go:108,447`), and it receives the interface as a plain parameter.</result>
